words.ps: ته په ډنډ کې لامبو وهې.

words.ps: موږ په کور کې خبرې کوو.

words.ps: زه د سیند پر غاړه کېنم.
words.roman: za da seend par ghāṛa kenam

words.ps: زه د سیند پر غاړه ګرځم.

words.ps: زه په کور کې کتاب لولم.
words.roman: za pa kor ke kitaab lolum
words.en: I read a book at home.

words.ps: زه په کور کې اوبه څښم.
words.roman: za pa kor ke oba ts-khum

words.ps: ته چای څښې او زه اوبه څښم.
words.roman: ta chaay tshey aw za oba tshkam
words.en: You drink tea, and I drink water.

words.ps: ته کوټه پاکوې او زه پر څوکۍ کښېنم.
words.roman: ta kota paakawey aw za par tsokey kenam
words.en: You clean the room, and I sit on the chair.

words.ps: ته کړکۍ خلاصوې او زه کوټه پاکوم.
words.roman: ta karkay khlaasawey aw za kota paakawum
words.en: You open the window, and I clean the room.

words.ps: ته مڼې اخلې او زه کڅوړه وړم.
words.roman: ta manay akhley aw za katswara wrum
words.en: You buy apples, and I carry a bag.

words.roman: ta dodai akhley aw za manay akhlam
words.en: You buy bread, and I buy apples.

words.ps: ته مرغۍ وینې او زه کب وینم.
words.roman: ta marghay weeney aw za kab weenam
words.en: You see a bird, and I see a fish.

words.ps: ته اوبه څښې او زه کب وینم.
words.roman: ta oba tshey aw za kab weenam
words.en: You drink water, and I see a fish.

words.ps: ته کتاب لولې او زه کلمه لیکم.
words.roman: ta kitaab loley aw za kalima leekam
words.en: You read a book, and I write a word.

words.ps: ته درس زده کوې او زه کتاب لولم.
words.roman: ta dars zda kawey aw za kitaab lolam
words.en: You learn a lesson, and I read a book.

words.ps: تاسې چای څښئ او زه اوبه څښم.
words.roman: taase chaay tshkey aw za oba tshkam
words.en: You drink tea, and I drink water. (polite)

words.ps: تاسې سبزي اخلئ او زه ډوډۍ اخلم.
words.roman: taase sabzee akhley aw za dodai akhlam
words.en: You buy vegetables, and I buy bread. (plural)

words.ps: تاسې مرغۍ وینئ او زه کب وینم.
words.roman: taase marghay weeney aw za kab weenam
words.en: You see a bird, and I see a fish. (plural)

words.ps: تاسې اوبه څښئ او زه چای څښم.
words.roman: taase oba tshkey aw za chaay tshkam
words.en: You drink water, and I drink tea. (plural)

words.ps: تاسې کتاب لولئ او زه کلمه لیکم.
words.roman: taase kitaab loley aw za kalima leekam
words.en: You read a book, and I write a word. (polite/plural)

words.ps: زه د جهیل تر څنګ منډې وهم.

words.ps: مینا او زه یو ځای منډې وهو.
words.roman: meena aw za yaw dzay mande waho

words.roman: taase dwaara da seend tar tsang gardzey
words.en: You both walk beside the river.
Mina and I open the door.

words.ps: تاسې دواړه له محمد جان سره مرسته کوئ.
words.roman: taase dwaara la muhammad jaan sara mrasta kawey

words.ps: موږ د ماښامنۍ لپاره سابه اخلو.

words.ps: موږ یو ځای پوښتنو ته ځوابونه ورکوو.
words.roman: moong yaw dzay pukhtano ta dzawaaboona warkawo

words.ps: هغوی په غرفه کې ډوډۍ پلوري.
words.roman: haghoy pa ghurfa ke ḍoḍay ploree
words.en: They sell bread at the stall.

words.ps: هغوی له محمد جان سره مرسته کوي.
words.roman: haghoy la muhammad jaan sara mrasta kawee

words.ps: هغوی د اوبو تر څنګ ګرځي.
words.roman: haghoy da obo tar tsang gardzee

words.ps: موږ د جهیل تر څنګ یو ځای ګرځو.
words.roman: moong da jaheel tar tsang yaw dzay gardzo
words.en: We walk together beside the lake.

words.ps: مینا او زه یو ځای ګرځو.
words.roman: meena aw za yaw dzay gardzo

words.en: Mina and I see the village.

words.ps: زه سیند وینم او موږ غونډۍ وینو.
words.roman: za seend weenam aw moong ghuṇḍay weeno
words.en: I see the river, and we see the hills.

words.ps: ته کوټه پاکوې او زه پر څوکۍ کښېنم.
words.roman: ta koṭa paakawey aw za par tsawkay kenam
words.en: You clean the room, and I sit on the chair.

words.ps: زه کتاب لولم او ته جمله لیکې.
words.roman: za kitaab lwalam aw ta jumla leekey
words.en: I read the book, and you write a sentence.

words.ps: موږ سابه اخلو او هغوی ډوډۍ اخلي.
words.roman: moong saaba akhlo aw haghoy ḍoḍay akhlee
words.en: We buy vegetables, and they buy bread.

words.ps: تاسې کتابونه لولئ او موږ جملې لیکو.
words.roman: taase kitaaboona lwaley aw moong jumle leeko
words.en: You all read books, and we write sentences.

words.ps: دروازه خلاصه ده او هغوی کوټه پاکوي.
words.roman: darwaaza khlaasa da aw haghoy koṭa paakawee
words.en: The door is open, and they clean the room.

words.ps: هغه مرغۍ ونې ته نږدې ده.
words.roman: hagha marghay wane ta negde da
words.en: That bird is near the tree.

words.ps: دا تیږه د اوبو تر څنګ ده.
words.roman: daa teegha da obo tar tsang da
words.en: This stone is beside the water.

words.ps: دا ډوډۍ د ماښامنۍ لپاره ده.
words.roman: daa ḍoḍay da maakhaamnay lapaara da

words.ps: په ټولګي کې درې زده کوونکي دي.
words.roman: pa ṭolgee ke dre zda kawoonkee dee
words.en: There are three students in the classroom.

words.ps: صالحه د جهیل تر څنګ ده.
words.roman: saaleha da jaheel tar tsang da

words.en: The fish is in the river.
The book is on the table.
The notebook is in the classroom.
The apples are in the basket.
The grocer is at the shop.

words.ps: څوکۍ د دروازې تر څنګ ده.
words.roman: tsawkay da darwaaze tar tsang da
words.en: The chair is beside the door.
The book is on the table.

words.ps: کتاب په دې کوټه کې دی.
words.roman: kitaab pa de koṭa ke day
words.en: The book is in this room.

words.ps: دا د محمد جان کتاب دی.
words.roman: daa da muhammad jaan kitaab day

words.en: Your notebook is on the table.
How many apples do you buy?

words.ps: په دې کڅوړه کې څه دي؟
words.roman: pa de katsoṛa ke tsa dee

words.ps: د جهیل تر څنګ څوک منډې وهي؟
words.roman: da jaheel tar tsang tsok mande wahee
words.en: Who is running beside the lake?

words.ps: کومه مرغۍ اوبو ته نږدې ده؟
words.roman: kooma marghay obo ta negde da
words.en: Which bird is near the water?
How many fish do we see?

words.ps: هغوی کله کله د جهیل تر څنګ کښېني.
words.roman: haghoy kala kala da jaheel tar tsang kenee
words.en: They sometimes sit beside the lake.

words.ps: ادریس هره ورځ خپل دوکان خلاصوي.
words.roman: edrees hara wraz khpal dookaan khlaasawee
words.en: Edris opens his shop every day.

words.ps: ته تل په کور کې مرسته کوې.
words.roman: ta tal pa kor ke mrasta kawey

words.ps: ستاسې کتاب پر هغې څوکۍ دی.
words.roman: staase kitaab par haghe tsawkay day
words.en: Your book is on that chair.

words.ps: د محمد جان کتابچه چېرته ده؟
words.roman: da muhammad jaan kitaabcha cherta da

words.ps: هغه خلک یو ځای ډوډۍ وړي.
words.roman: hagha khalak yaw dzay ḍoḍay wree

words.ps: هغه مرغان سیند ته نږدې دي.
words.roman: hagha marghaan seend ta negde dee
words.en: Those birds are near the river.
